question: Why did the number of orders drop in April 2018 compared to March 2018?

report.summary: Total orders dropped by 731.0 (-10.14%) in April 2018 compared to March 2018 [Q1]. The decrease was primarily driven by a sharp drop in orders from customer state MG, accounting for 63.32% of the total change [Q2].
report.root_cause_explanation: Orders from customer state MG fell by 552.0, dropping from 879.0 in March to 327.0 in April [Q2]. Within MG, customer city Belo Horizonte saw orders fall by 139.0, from 223.0 to 84.0 [Q3]. This localized drop aligns with operational updates noting that the fulfilment hub serving Minas Gerais was paused for flood-damage repairs, leading to longer delivery estimates [D1].
next_checks: Verify if the Minas Gerais (MG) fulfilment hub has fully resumed normal operations following the flood-damage repairs.
Check whether marketplace sellers have restored their temporarily hidden listings for MG postcodes.
Review customer support inquiry volumes from MG regarding extended delivery times.
report.suggested_experiment: Run a targeted promotional campaign or free shipping incentive for MG postcodes now that operations are restoring, and closely monitor the weekly order volume from the MG segment.

related_documents.title: Ops update: Belo Horizonte fulfilment hub paused
related_documents.excerpt:
The fulfilment hub serving Minas Gerais (MG) is paused for three weeks for a flood-damage repair. During this period checkout shows longer delivery estimates for MG postcodes and several marketplace sellers temporarily hid their listings for MG.

Expect lower order volume from MG customers in April. Other states are served from Sao Paulo as usual.

related_documents.title: SOP: investigating a rise in late deliveries
related_documents.excerpt:
1. Confirm the metric: late = delivered after order_estimated_delivery_date, among delivered orders only.
2. Break down by customer state, seller state and seller to see whether the rise is regional or seller-specific.
3. Check carrier incident logs for the same weeks.
4. If one region dominates, contact the regional carrier manager before changing delivery promises.

related_documents.title: Quality alert: faulty batch from a health & beauty supplier
related_documents.excerpt:
A large supplier in the beleza_saude (health & beauty) category shipped a batch of products with broken seals and leaking containers. Customers who received items from this batch in May are leaving 1-star reviews.

Action: remove the batch from sale, offer refunds, and monitor the review score for the category.
